faq_data.question: How do I track my order?
patterns: How can I check the status of my order?
Where is my shipment right now?
faq_data.answer: You can track your order in real-time by visiting the 'Order History' section in your account or by clicking the tracking link sent to your email after shipment. You can also enter your Tracking ID on our Track Order page.

faq_data.question: Can I cancel or modify my order after placing it?
patterns: Can I change the items in my order?
Can I edit my order before it ships?
Can I cancel my purchase before it ships?
faq_data.answer: Orders can be modified or canceled within 60 minutes of placement from your 'Order Details' page. Once processing begins in our warehouse, orders cannot be canceled, but you can return them free of charge once delivered.

faq_data.question: How long does shipping take and what are the delivery options?
patterns: How many days will delivery take?
faq_data.answer: We offer standard shipping (3-5 business days) and express priority shipping (1-2 business days). Orders placed before 2:00 PM EST on weekdays ship the same day.

faq_data.question: Do you offer international shipping?
patterns: Can I order from outside the United States?
Can you deliver to Europe or Canada?
faq_data.answer: Yes, we ship to over 85 countries worldwide! International shipping usually takes 7-14 business days. Any applicable customs duties or import taxes will be calculated at checkout.

faq_data.question: What happens if I am not home during delivery?
patterns: What if I'm not home when package arrives?
Do I need to sign for delivery?
What if nobody is home for the delivery?
faq_data.answer: If you are not available, the courier will leave a notice card and attempt redelivery the next business day. High-value orders requiring a signature can be redirected to a local courier pickup point through your tracking portal.

faq_data.question: What is your return policy and how do I return an item?
patterns: How do I return a product?
Can I return an opened item?
How do I return an opened box product?
Send back an item for return
faq_data.answer: We offer a 30-day hassle-free return window for all items in original condition and packaging. To initiate a return, go to Account > Returns & Refunds to generate a prepaid return shipping label.

faq_data.question: How long does it take to receive my refund?
patterns: When will I get my refund?
How many days for refund to show up?
When does the money get credited back for my return?
faq_data.answer: Once our warehouse inspects your returned product (typically 2-3 business days), refunds are issued immediately. It usually takes 3-7 business days to reflect on your original payment method.

faq_data.question: What should I do if my item arrives damaged or defective?
patterns: My screen arrived broken and damaged
faq_data.answer: We apologize for the trouble! Please report damaged or defective items within 48 hours of delivery. Upload photos in the Returns portal, and we will send a complimentary expedited replacement immediately.

faq_data.question: What payment methods do you accept?
patterns: Can I pay with credit card?
Do you accept Apple Pay or Google Pay?
Do you accept Apple Pay or PayPal?
faq_data.answer: We accept major credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and flexible installments through Klarna and Affirm. We currently do not support Cash on Delivery.

faq_data.question: Is my payment and personal information secure?
patterns: Is it safe to pay on this website?
Do you store my credit card details?
Is my credit card information encrypted and secure?
faq_data.answer: Yes, your transactions are 100% secure. We utilize end-to-end 256-bit SSL encryption and comply with Level 1 PCI-DSS standards. We never store your full payment card details on our servers.

faq_data.question: Do your products come with a warranty?
patterns: What does the 1 year warranty cover?
faq_data.answer: All brand-new electronic devices include a standard 1-Year Limited Manufacturer Warranty covering hardware defects and malfunctions. Optional NovaCare Extended Warranty is available at checkout for accidental drop/spill coverage.

faq_data.question: How do I claim a warranty repair or replacement?
patterns: How to file a warranty claim?
My device stopped working under warranty
Fix my broken gadget under warranty
How to request a repair for my broken gadget under warranty?
faq_data.answer: To claim your warranty, visit the 'Warranty Support' page with your serial number and invoice. Our tech support team will troubleshoot the issue or provide a prepaid shipping box for authorized repair.

faq_data.question: How do I reset my password?
patterns: I forgot my password and cannot sign in
faq_data.answer: Click 'Sign In' at the top right, select 'Forgot Password?', enter your registered email address, and we will send you a secure password reset link within minutes.

faq_data.question: How do I update my delivery address or account details?
patterns: Change account email or phone number
Change the shipping destination address in my profile
faq_data.answer: Go to 'My Profile' > 'Address Book' to add, edit, or set default delivery addresses. Note: changing your address here does not alter existing orders already in transit; contact support for in-flight adjustments.

faq_data.question: Do you offer student, military, or healthcare discounts?
patterns: Do you have coupons for students?
Are there coupon codes for college students?
faq_data.answer: Yes! We offer a 10% discount for verified students, educators, active military, and first responders through our ID.me integration. Verify your status at checkout to apply your savings instantly.

faq_data.question: How do I apply a promo code or gift card to my order?
patterns: Where do I enter promo code?
Where do I enter my promo voucher code?
faq_data.answer: On the Checkout page, look for the 'Promo / Gift Card' box below your order summary. Enter your code and click 'Apply' to see your balance deducted from the total.

faq_data.question: How do I know if an item is in stock or when it will be restocked?
patterns: Notify me when back in stock
When will out-of-stock headphones be available?
faq_data.answer: Real-time stock availability is displayed directly on each product page. If an item is sold out, click the 'Notify Me When Available' button to receive an instant email as soon as new inventory arrives.

faq_data.question: What is the condition of refurbished or open-box products?
patterns: Are certified refurbished devices safe to buy?
Is it safe to buy refurbished gadgets?
faq_data.answer: All 'Certified Refurbished' products undergo a rigorous 65-point inspection, thorough sanitization, and battery health verification. They arrive in pristine cosmetic condition with all accessories and a 6-month warranty.

faq_data.question: How can I contact a human customer support agent?
patterns: I want to speak with a human customer service agent
faq_data.answer: You can reach our live support team 24/7 via phone at 1-800-555-NOVA, email us at support@novatech-electronics.com, or request a live agent right here between 8 AM and 10 PM EST.

faq_data.question: Can I change the delivery address for an order that is already placed?
patterns: Update shipping destination for placed order
Can I change the shipping address for an existing order?
faq_data.answer: If your order has not yet been processed (within 1 hour of ordering), contact our support team immediately or edit it under 'Recent Orders'. If already dispatched, you can reroute via the courier's tracking portal.
